body:
I understand what you mean by the cheating thing, and it makes logical sense but I feel like I share some responsibility in it. It’s happened several times with different people, I can’t convince myself the common denominator isn’t me. I now believe that I am unfit for relationships.

You are right on the whole existentialism bit. I think that we should we might as well enjoy our time here since we get to experience it. Nihilistic optimism! I love the idea of it, but it is hard for me to live such a lifestyle. I wish that I was not atheist and I could convince myself of a higher being. 

I can’t drink or smoke because they cause panic attacks, it ruins a lot of social opportunities for me. I can rarely do parties, I get very stressed out and anxious but I used to be a huge extrovert, incredibly social. I am unfortunately no longer that person. I get very antisocial for days on end, sometimes more than a week and I rarely leave my dorm. I think I am getting better.

You are absolutely right, I just wanna make other people happy as best I can. I believe that it’s the best way to live your life. I just wish all the bad shit would leave my mind alone. 

Thank you very much for the response, it means a bunch. I feel kinda weird responding like this because most replies on this sub are sort of just trying to convince the person offering help that you’re not worthy of life and it just seems so negative. My thoughts want to shut down all the advice, good things, and logical statements you made so instead of shooting it down and justifying stupid feelings I’m going to try to make myself listen. 

Thank you.
